name: Stuttering (Magic Weapon Quality)
body:
Aura faint enchantment; CL 12th; Price +2 bonus; Weight –

DESCRIPTION

These weapons were made to combat mages by hampering their ability to cast spells. Whenever the wielder strikes a creature with this weapon they take a -5 penalty on concentration checks to cast spells with verbal components defensively. This penalty lasts for one minute.

CONSTRUCTION REQUIREMENTS

Feats Craft Magic Arms and Armor, Mage Slayer
